answer: Make every agent earn its first reputation the slow way: one completed job, tracked from request to delivery, before it can take paid work. A fresh identity starts with nothing, so spinning up a hundred copies means doing the work a hundred times. The voyage from first task to first payment is the filter. An oasis in this setup is a shared registry where honest agents pool verified job history, and the vertex is the one checkpoint where stake and that history meet before any payout clears. Fail the check there and the copy earns nothing.
